violations.description: General employee practices. — --Food employee observed without proper hair restraint.
Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not provided in creamer dispenser. Needs thermometer.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Handle on walk-in-cooler needs cleaned of debris.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor in walk-in-cooler needs cleaned. Walls in dishwashing & cooking area need cleaned of debris.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as needed. - Under shelves and floor of walk-in cooler in need of cleaning. - Fronts, sides, and backs of prep tables/ kitchen equipment in need of cleaning.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in the proper location to protect from contamination. - Scoop for large ice machine stored directly on machine. Needs to be stored inverted in a clean bucket or hung on side of machine to prevent contamination.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Floors and walls in kitchen needs spot cleaning throughout.
